replacement_lines: Generation is how you currently obtain a decision.
Obtaining a decision that way does not make generation and decision the same act.
The measurements in this chapter are the evidence that conflating them is expensive.
That is the whole claim so far.
Whether a decision deserves to be a programming construct is [Chapter 16](/books/jev/16-chapter/).
Whether a decision model is a distinct category of model is [Chapter 2](/books/jev/02-chapter/).

That is the whole claim so far: generation and decision are not the same act; the programming-construct question is [Chapter 16](/books/jev/16-chapter/), and the model-category question is [Chapter 2](/books/jev/02-chapter/).
